Population increased in Tameside

The estimated population of Tameside in 2024 was 239,643 usual residents, a rise of 1.5% since 2023.

This meant that Tameside's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Tameside increased by 3.6%.

Over this slightly longer period, Tameside was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Tameside

The average (median) age fell to 39.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Tameside has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Tameside is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Tameside's population of 239,643 usual residents was made up of:

  • 46,800 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.5%)
  • 150,674 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.9%)
  • 42,169 people aged 65 years and over, (17.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Tameside has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (17.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Tameside, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Tameside
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Tameside, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 107 people (0%). In total, there were 2,466 births and 2,359 deaths in Tameside.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,114 (0.5%). There were 12,198 people entering the area and 11,084 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Tameside's population of 2,279 (1%) as a result of 2,917 people entering the area and 638 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Tameside was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Tameside in mid-2023 is 236,142.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,217 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 259 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,476 people.
